items.text: Adults 21 and over may possess up to 2.5 ounces of cannabis or 1/4 ounce of concentrate (limit raised from 1 ounce on 1 January 2024), bought only from state-licensed stores with photo ID. No use in any public place or a moving vehicle (even as a passenger); private property if the owner allows, or a licensed consumption lounge.

sources.title: Laws and regulations
sources.supports: possession limits and where to consume

psychoactive-substances.notes: State or provincial law. Read with the national rules (in the US, cannabis stays illegal federally: no federal land, no crossing state lines).
